content.introduction: Oil prices jumped by over 4%, while shares on the Kospi fell 9% with SK Hynix shares sinking by over 15% on a mixed day for Asian markets. SK Hynix's record $26bn IPO from its US listing invigorated AI trade and boosted Asia stocks. Indonesia was expected to record a larger trade surplus of about $630 million in August, and its inflation rate for September was projected to rise slightly. Indonesia's central bank increased its purchases of government bonds in September to pump up liquidity. The Indian rupee was among the worst performers in Asia this quarter and over the last 30 days, hit by elevated crude prices and surging global bond yields. Singapore state investor Temasek planned to open offices in Riyadh and Abu Dhabi in the first half of 2027, seeking investment and partnership opportunities across the Middle East.

Oil prices jumped by over 4%, while shares on the Kospi fell 9%, as SK Hynix shares sank by over 15% on another mixed day for Asian markets.

Asia-Pacific companies are poised to challenge ​their 2021 record for share and convertible bond fundraising this year, as an AI boom ‌drives investment in chips, data centres and power systems.
 Indonesia was expected to record a larger trade surplus of about $630 ​million in August, while its inflation ‌rate for September was projected to rise slightly, according to a Reuters poll of economists. [...] Indonesia's central bank has increased its purchases of government bonds in the secondary market ​in September in a bid to pump up liquidity, an ‌official said on Wednesday.
 Gold surrendered earlier gains and eased on Wednesday, ‌heading for a monthly decline, as higher energy prices eclipsed support from softer-than-expected U.S. inflation data that reduced expectations for an immediate Federal Reserve rate hike. [...] The Indian rupee was among the worst performers in Asia this quarter and over the last 30 days, hit by worries over ​elevated crude prices and surging global bond yields that added to headwinds ‌for local assets.
 Singapore state investor Temasek said on Wednesday it planned to open offices in Riyadh ​and Abu Dhabi in the first half of 2027, ‌subject to approvals, seeking investment and partnership opportunities across the Middle East.
